items.name: How-to / tutorial article
items.one_line: Step-by-step article that gets the reader from problem to a finished task, with ordered steps and checks.

items.name: Influencer campaign brief
items.one_line: The document that tells a paid creator the objective, key messages, deliverables, do/don'ts and disclosure rules.

items.note: In India the brief must carry ASCI disclosure instructions for paid or gifted content.

items.name: Infographic copy
items.one_line: Headline, data points, labels and source line for an infographic, written so the visual tells one story at a glance.
items.value_evidence: Upwork lists infographics among technical-writer projects (2026-01-21); usually bundled with design work.

items.value_evidence: Bundled into Instagram management; no separate marketplace facet found on 2026-10-04.
items.note: One idea per frame; keep text inside the safe zone away from UI and faces.

items.value_evidence: No dedicated marketplace category found on 2026-10-04; built inside quiz tools by marketing teams.
items.note: Every result must feel like a win for the person who gets it.

items.name: Internal FAQ
items.one_line: A question-and-answer document that pre-empts what employees or partners will ask about a change, policy or launch.
items.value_evidence: Written in-house by HR, comms or product teams.
items.note: Write the hard questions people will actually ask, answer each in the first sentence. Owner and last-updated date at top.

items.name: Internal memo / business email (internal)
items.one_line: A short internal message that informs or asks colleagues for a decision, readable in one pass.
items.value_evidence: Everyday workplace writing; taught, not commissioned.
items.note: Subject line states the ask. Bottom line up front, then context, then next steps with owners and dates. Indian government 'office memorandum' has its own fixed format.

items.name: Internal / employee newsletter
items.one_line: Recurring update for employees that explains company news, recognises people and makes leadership decisions understandable.
items.value_evidence: Upwork lists internal communications among business-writer projects (2026-01-21); mostly done by in-house comms teams.

items.name: Interview Q&A article

items.note: Answers are edited for clarity and length but never changed in meaning; get the subject's approval when the brief promises it.
